responsibility: Implements C++ call construction, overload resolution, and implicit conversion sequencing. This is the front end's core for collecting overload candidates, selecting functions, methods, constructors, and conversion operators, ranking candidates with standard/user-defined conversion chains, building the chosen call expression, and handling C++ initialization-side call semantics such as reference binding, temporary lifetime extension, argument-passing conversions, std::initializer_list treatment, and diagnostics for bad or dangerous conversions. It is most relevant to bugs where the correct declaration is visible but call viability, conversion ranking, list initialization, or reference-temporary handling is wrong.
